instructions: Read the primary source in full. Do not infer missing text from abstracts/search snippets. A technically successful full-text fetch is not sufficient when tables, appendices, or other evidence needed for the five slots are missing; continue through the ordered official full-text routes and use the next route only to fill the missing primary evidence. Follow workflow v10 fixed-slot transport; do not send completed Markdown from Scheduled Chat.
